title: Local AI for List Hygiene: Assistance, Not the Suppression Rule
author: Stefan Bogdanescu
excerpt: Bounce handling, complaints and unsubscribes affect whether another message should be sent. Do not let a language model override an unsubscribe or an established suppression rule. AI can help interpret or group ambiguous reports while deterministic controls govern sending.
content:
Keep the delivery rules explicit

Bounce handling, complaints and unsubscribes affect whether another message should be sent. Do not let a language model override an unsubscribe or an established suppression rule. AI can help interpret or group ambiguous reports while deterministic controls govern sending.

Distinguish a bounce from an unsubscribe

A hard bounce describes a delivery failure; an unsubscribe records a recipient's preference. They can both stop future sending for different reasons, but they are not the same event. Preserve that distinction in reports and audits.

Test classification on labeled examples

Use a reviewed set of bounce messages and measure errors, including temporary failures incorrectly treated as permanent. Route ambiguous cases for review. Do not claim a classifier is precise merely because its output looks structured.

Check the privacy and cost boundary

Local inference can keep this analysis on infrastructure you control when configured that way. It still needs compute, access controls and log-retention decisions. A remotely configured endpoint or cloud model changes the data path. Verify those settings before processing behavioral data.

Sources and scope

Configuration and test results determine the behavior of an individual installation. This guide does not certify a live deployment or promise a cost, deliverability or compliance result.
